summary: Static code analysis and verification of all 20 Atlas sync engine fixes. All 23 tests passed (100% success rate). Each flaw fix was verified through code inspection.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 20 sync engine fixes verified via static code analysis. Tests are in /app/backend/tests/test_atlas_sync_20_fixes.py

flaw_1_poller_lie.details: _run_realtime_sync docstring correctly states 'catches NEW conversations only' and 'creation date'

flaw_2_message_sync_poisoning.details: _process_conversation_batch uses 'last_message_synced_at' (line 1203) for skip logic, _sync_fields updates last_synced_at (line 818)

flaw_3_tag_removal.details: _sync_fields uses 'if tag_lookup is not None' (line 750) and sets mapped_tags=[] when raw_tags empty (line 754)

flaw_4_90d_invisibility.details: _run_cold_crawl_batch params only include cursor and limit (line 1359), no startDate filter

flaw_5_csat_closed_at_one_shot.details: _sync_fields has no 'not ticket.get(closed_at)' or 'not ticket.get(atlas_csat_score)' guards. Allows re-updates (lines 767-785)

flaw_7_14_error_boundary.details: _process_conversation_batch has try/except per conversation (line 1185), consecutive_failures tracking (line 1174), MAX_CONSECUTIVE_FAILURES=5 abort (line 1240)

flaw_8_tag_cache.details: _get_cached_tag_lookup checks 'if fresh or not _lookup_cache[tag_lookup]' (line 132) to avoid poisoning cache with empty results

flaw_9_false_positive_matching.details: _create_or_link_ticket Match 2 includes source filter '$in: [email, imap, gmail]' (line 511) and timedelta(days=7) constraint (line 502)

flaw_12_redundant_poller_sync.details: _run_realtime_sync skips message sync if last_message_synced_at < 120 seconds (line 1098)

flaw_15_webhook_async.details: atlas_webhooks.py uses threading.Thread (line 45), daemon=True (line 48), returns 200 immediately

flaw_18_message_text.details: _sync_messages checks 'not plain_text and not raw_attachments' (line 596), allowing attachment-only messages

flaw_20_tags_double_update.details: _webhook_tags_changed only calls _sync_fields (line 965) for updates, no direct tag update

webhook_health.details: Webhook health endpoint returns ok at /api/webhooks/atlas/health
